Container.Name: paperclip-notifier
Container.Overview: Self-contained Paperclip Activity notifier. Native Unraid deployment uses IFTTT Webhooks as the initial notification path; IFTTT can then send Discord notifications. Direct Discord, Telegram, and generic GET/POST webhooks remain optional. Configure /config/config.yaml and provide secrets as masked runtime environment variables. The container is read-only and persists SQLite state in /data.

Config.Name: Config directory
Config.Description: Directory containing config.yaml. Store this outside the image and restrict permissions.

Config.Name: Persistent data
Config.Description: SQLite state, outbox, checkpoints, and dead-letter records.

Config.Name: Health/API port
Config.Description: Optional local health/status endpoint. Do not expose publicly.

Environment.Name: PAPERCLIP_BASE_URL
Environment.Description: Paperclip API base URL. Native bridge deployment uses the host-published LAN port 3200.

Environment.Name: PAPERCLIP_PUBLIC_URL
Environment.Description: Public browser origin used to build clickable links.

Environment.Name: PAPERCLIP_API_KEY
Environment.Description: Paperclip board API key. Supply through Unraid's masked environment-variable field; never commit it.

Environment.Name: IFTTT_WEBHOOK_URL
Environment.Description: Complete IFTTT Webhooks URL, including event path and private key. Supply through Unraid's masked environment-variable field; never commit it.

Environment.Name: DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL
Environment.Description: Optional direct Discord webhook URL. Supply only as a masked runtime variable when enabled.

Environment.Name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
Environment.Description: Optional Telegram bot token. Supply only as a masked runtime variable when enabled.

Environment.Name: TZ
Environment.Description: Container timezone; event timestamps remain UTC.
